params.prompt: Bold, simple, instantly readable mobile app ad visual, 4:5 vertical. ONE single huge glossy 3D icon object in the exact center of the frame (occupying the middle 30%-80% height), with a big bright red circular notification badge attached to its top-right corner showing only an exclamation mark symbol. Solid saturated flat background color with a very subtle radial glow, nothing else in the scene. Upper 28% of frame completely empty, bottom 15% completely empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no hands, no money. Clean high-end 3D icon style like a premium app promo. Icon: two glossy 3D person figure icons side by side on small round podiums, a large white person figure on a tall podium and a smaller red person figure on a low podium; the red notification badge with a question mark symbol is on the small red figure. Background: vivid warm orange.
